stages.label: History
stages.text: 64-year-old with four months of medial knee pain, worse on stairs. Walks two miles most days. Has taken occasional over-the-counter analgesics. Has not had physical therapy, a structured exercise program, or an injection. Asks about knee replacement.

stages.label: Imaging report
stages.text: Standing radiographs: mild to moderate medial joint space narrowing with small osteophytes. No fracture, no lesion.

stages.label: Exam
stages.text: Medial joint line tenderness, small effusion, full extension, flexion to 125 degrees, stable ligaments, normal gait.

guideline.note: Non-operative care first: exercise therapy, weight management, analgesia, with reassessment.

attending.note: Start supervised therapy; revisit if function declines despite it.
